reports.description: In December 2021, I came upon the Favor Trades investment platform after reading about them online. I was looking to invest some of my savings to fund my son‚Äôs upcoming university education, and as such decided to sign up with the platform. After filling out an online form, I was called by an individual called Daniel Sterling. This individual helped the client set up his account and make his first deposit. The following day, then Claudio Reyes also called me, introducing him was account manager of my account. The client set up an account with NDAX.io, a Canadian cryptocurrency exchange. I communicate with Claudio Reyes through phone and Whatsapp. He used AnyDesk (510 481 050) to place trades for me. I was promised that I would receive ‚Äúhuge guaranteed returns‚Äù and that I would only have to pay a commission upon withdrawal. Then I was trading in the Forex market with the platform and was pressured into making additional deposits into the platform in Bitcoin. I was told that ‚ÄúNo one had ever lost money on investing in BTC‚Äù among other statements in order to get him to invest more. I was also offered credits to my balance by the company. Following the lack of deposits to my account, Favor Trades emptied my balance at the end of January 2022. I made my last transfer to the scammers‚Äô Bitcoin wallet on the 13th of January, 2021.
